basic_steps: Form two equal rows facing each other
Sing antiphonal chants led by the main singer
Step into the space between lines while carrying a wooden replica rifle
Execute choreographed movements holding the rifle in time to the drum rhythm
teaching.formation: Two facing lines of male singers with dancers filling the center space
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start by joining the facing rows to observe and chant along before handling replica rifles in the center space.
teaching.rhythm: Antiphonal drum rhythm accompanying sung Nabati poetry
